visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a brown tabby cat resting its head on a light blue pillow in a brightly lit indoor room. The cat has green eyes and looks directly at the camera with a neutral expression. A red and orange logo is visible in the top right corner. Large white text with a black border appears at the bottom. The scene cuts to a tortoiseshell cat lying on a light-colored wooden floor, illuminated by a rectangular patch of sunlight. The cat licks its paw and grooms its face with relaxed movements. (2) The shot transitions back to a tabby cat on a white surface near a window. A human hand enters from the left and strokes the cat's head repeatedly, causing the cat's ears to flatten and its mouth to slightly open. The background shows a blurry interior with a window. An orange and white cat is then shown sitting on a grey carpeted floor, looking away from the camera. The setting is clean with soft, diffused indoor lighting. (3) An orange cat sits on a white windowsill with sunlight streaming through the window, grooming its side fur. The camera cuts to a person's hand using a grey plastic sifting scoop to clean a litter box. The scoop moves through grey sandy litter, lifting and shaking it to isolate clumps. The background is a white tiled floor. A cut shows the orange cat's face in a close-up as it continues to groom itself. (4) An orange and white cat is seen scratching the wooden leg of a cabinet. A white cat with black patches then scratches a curved cardboard scratching pad on a wooden floor. The camera moves to a calico cat standing on the same cardboard pad, vigorously scratching the surface with its front paws. The lighting remains bright and natural throughout the interior shots. (5) A human hand uses a purple silicone brush to groom the back of an orange cat sitting on a grey fabric chair. The cat looks out a bright window as the brush collects loose white and orange fur. The final shot is a close-up of a white and grey cat's face resting on a white surface, with its eyes blinking slowly as it looks toward the camera. The video ends with a brand logo overlay.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 貓咪都很兇不要養啦！. [Logo]: 好味小姐 LADY FLAVOR. (2) [Subtitle]: 我們來幫貓咪們平反一下那些媽媽們說不准養貓的原因. (3) [Subtitle]: 1.貓咪看起來很兇欸！. (4) [Subtitle]: 從古至今貓咪們都被冠上貓咪很冷漠都不理人類的這種形象. (5) [Subtitle]: 但其實每隻貓咪的性格都很不一樣哦. (6) [Subtitle]: 像是短褲雖然常常臉很臭. (7) [Subtitle]: 但是遇到特別喜歡的人例如我就會拍屁屁蹭蹭樣樣來. (8) [Subtitle]: 那YIA呢就是屬於看到誰都可以很喜歡的外向貓咪. (9) [Subtitle]: 親人又撒嬌的貓咪也是到處都是啦！. (10) [Subtitle]: 2.貓味很臭吧？. (11) [Subtitle]: 這真的是很冤枉其實貓咪們是很愛乾淨的動物. (12) [Subtitle]: 一天中花非常多的時間在幫自己舔毛洗澡就是為去除殘留在身上的一些味道. (13) [Subtitle]: 既定印象的貓臭味其實指的是貓砂盆的味道啦！. (14) [Subtitle]: 這部分只要每天定期清潔就可以解決囉！. (15) [Subtitle]: 3.他們都會破壞傢俱啊！. (16) [Subtitle]: 主要原因在於貓咪們呢他們是需要磨指甲的動物. (17) [Subtitle]: 磨指甲會讓貓咪們感到舒壓而且還可以用來標記地盤算是他們的天性之一. (18) [Subtitle]: 所以家裡呢如果找不到東西或是貓抓板不夠的時候他們當然沒辦法只好向傢俱下手了. (19) [Subtitle]: 大家可以在家裡各處放上貓咪們喜歡材質的貓抓板. (20) [Subtitle]: 只要有東西讓貓咪們可以大抓特抓他們當然就不會找傢俱的麻煩啦！. (21) [Subtitle]: 4.貓毛滿天飛. (22) [Subtitle]: 每天固定幫貓咪梳掉換下來的廢毛搭配空氣清淨機以及吸塵器一起使用就可以大大減少生活中貓咪掉落的毛囉！. (23) [Subtitle]: 我是好味小姐那你知道了嗎？.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves to debunk four common misconceptions about owning cats: that they look too fierce, that they smell bad, that they destroy furniture, and that their hair shedding is unmanageable. By providing logical explanations and practical tips, the creator aims to encourage adoption and responsible pet ownership in a friendly, approachable way.
